title: Close all remaining open issue lanes

intent.outcome: Close every currently open GitHub issue through three reviewable stacked lanes: agent and skill guidance, lifecycle evidence, and canonical operating-decision composition.
non_goals: Do not create a universal instruction registry, a second operating-decision authority, or provider-specific lifecycle state.
Do not claim parent issue closure from a useful slice unless its acceptance criteria and composed proof are satisfied.
Leave issues opened after the 2026-08-16 inventory and unrelated backlog outside this plan.

parent.contribution: Resolve the complete open-issue inventory observed on 2026-08-16.
parent.closure_boundary: all listed issues require issue-level acceptance and proof before closure

next_action: Review and merge draft PRs #2596, #2600, and #2601 in stack order, then allow their closing keywords to close the listed issues.
